status: beta — not published; listed only when SATELINK_MCP_WORKFLOW_TOOLS=1
auth: SATELINK_API_KEY (customer API key). Every call is scoped to that customer.
spending: Purchases always pause for approval. approve_purchase only auto-approves when the quoted charge is at or below SATELINK_MCP_AUTO_APPROVE_MAX_USD (default 0); anything higher must be approved in the Satelink console.
idempotency: Mutating tools take idempotency_key; if omitted, a key is derived from the tool name and arguments, so a retried call never creates a second run.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Search the Satelink Agent Marketplace. Returns each capability with its suppliers, real status (live / preview / evaluation / paused), supported networks, price and last verification. Only offers marked purchasable can execute.

network.description: Optional network filter, e.g. polygon, base.

tools.name: quote_capability
tools.description: Compare suppliers for a capability on a network and return the supplier Satelink would use, the customer charge, list price and supplier cost. Returns available=false with per-supplier reasons when nothing can execute.

tools.name: request_capability_purchase
tools.description: Create a capped purchase of one capability call. The run pauses at awaiting_approval; nothing executes or is charged until it is approved. Failed or unverified calls are never charged.

budget_usd.description: Maximum USD for this call, e.g. '0.01'.

tools.name: approve_purchase
tools.description: Approve a purchase that is awaiting approval, then execute, verify and return the result and receipt. Refused (with a console link) when the quoted charge exceeds the operator's auto-approve limit.

tools.name: compile_strategy
tools.description: Turn a plain-language trading idea into a validated Satelink strategy spec, or return clarification questions, or reasons it cannot be evaluated. Supported: moving-average crossover and Donchian breakout, long-only, Binance spot BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT daily bars.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: Run a walk-forward backtest of a strategy (from a prompt or a spec) and return the evidence scorecard. SIMULATED / BACKTEST — NOT ACTUAL RETURNS. Never places orders.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Get one workflow run: status, step graph, result, receipt and execution trace.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List this customer's recent workflow runs (backtests and purchases).
